Adding a large pull-down resistor makes the DC point stable. M2 is sized to carry I1 plus the resistor current, and I1 rises to meet GBW."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),     # NMOS CS length (gate drive fixed at 0.75 V)
    "gmid2": (11.0, 9.5, 12.0),    # PMOS load/reference gm/Id
    "L2":    (0.3, 0.25, 0.3),     # PMOS load/reference length (same on M2 and M3)
    "IREF":  (6e-6, 5e-6, 6e-6),   # PMOS reference current (M3 diode)
    "K2":    (12.0, 10.0, 13.0),   # mirror ratio M2:M3 (integer)
    "RDC":   (5e5, 1e5, 5e5),      # DC pull-down resistor fixing the output level
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)   # reference current sourced by the testbench
    IREF = p["IREF"]
    L1 = p["L1"]
    L2 = p["L2"]
    K = int(round(p["K2"]))
    RDC = p["RDC"]

    VGS1 = 0.75     # fixed by the gate bias of the CS device
    VDS1 = 0.9      # target output DC level

    # --- PMOS load mirror: M3 = 1x unit (diode), M2 = Kx unit, same L ---
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], L2, IREF, vds=0.9)
    W_unit = opr.W
    op2 = lut.op("p", W_unit * K, L2, opr.vgs, VDS1)
    I2 = op2["Id"]                       # load current at Vsd = 0.9 V

    # --- Output balance: M2 current = M1 current + current through RDC at VDS1 ---
    I1 = I2 - VDS1 / RDC
    t = lut.op("n", 10.0, L1, VGS1, VDS1)
    W1 = 10.0 * I1 / t["Id"]
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, VGS1, VDS1)

    # --- NMOS sink mirror: M0 diode at testbench iref, M4 = width-scaled copy sinking IREF ---
    op0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    W4 = op0.W * IREF / iref
    L0 = 1.0

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)           # signal NMOS CS
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_unit * K, L2)    # PMOS load, K x unit
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)                       # PMOS diode, 1x unit
    n.M("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W4, L0)           # NMOS sink: IREF
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", op0)                 # NMOS diode at ibias
    n.R("R1", "vout", "vss", RDC)                                    # DC stabilising pull-down

    # --- analytic predictions ---
    gm1 = op1["gm"]
    gds1 = op1["gds"]
    gds2 = op2["gds"]
    G = gds1 + gds2 + 1.0 / RDC
    gain = gm1 / G
    f3db = G / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I2 + iref + IREF)
    swing = (VDD - opr.vdsat) - op1["vdsat"]

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": VDS1,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
